title: Discovery question bank — D2
purpose: Working sequence for Discovery question bank: business driver, availability and recovery targets, load shape, data location, constraints, and success measures.
routing_rationale: Use the D2 lens to keep business driver, availability and recovery targets, load shape, data location, constraints, and success measures connected to an explicit owner, evidence path, and recovery action.
summary: Move from a client business driver to measurable availability, load, data, risk, and success criteria.

nodes.label: Client Sponsor
nodes.detail: The stakeholder who explains why the project exists.

nodes.label: Business Driver
nodes.detail: The outcome that should anchor all technical questions.

nodes.label: Availability / RTO / RPO
nodes.detail: The measurable service and recovery objectives.

nodes.label: Peak and Average Load
nodes.detail: The traffic shape, not just a single peak number.

nodes.label: Data and Regulation
nodes.detail: Where users and data may legally or operationally reside.

nodes.label: Existing Systems and Skills
nodes.detail: Constraints that shape migration, operations, and supportability.

nodes.label: Success Measures
nodes.detail: How the customer will decide the architecture worked.

steps.title: Working sequence: Business Driver → Availability / RTO / RPO
steps.action: Business Driver what must hold? to Availability / RTO / RPO; record evidence for business driver, availability and recovery targets, load shape, data location, constraints, and success measures.
steps.why_traversal: Follow the handoff sequence for Discovery question bank by making Availability / RTO / RPO an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e2 for Discovery question bank

steps.title: Working sequence: Availability / RTO / RPO → Peak and Average Load
steps.action: Availability / RTO / RPO size the service to Peak and Average Load; record evidence for business driver, availability and recovery targets, load shape, data location, constraints, and success measures.
steps.why_traversal: Follow the handoff sequence for Discovery question bank by making Peak and Average Load an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e3 for Discovery question bank

steps.title: Working sequence: Availability / RTO / RPO → Data and Regulation
steps.action: Availability / RTO / RPO bound the design to Data and Regulation; record evidence for business driver, availability and recovery targets, load shape, data location, constraints, and success measures.
steps.why_traversal: Follow the handoff sequence for Discovery question bank by making Data and Regulation an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e4 for Discovery question bank

scenarios.label: The solution answers the wrong driver
scenarios.root_cause: Technical activity is mistaken for the business outcome.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Discovery question bank path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Business Driver and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Restate the driver and obtain sponsor confirmation.

check.command: review d2 evidence for Business Driver

scenarios.label: Targets remain qualitative
scenarios.root_cause: No availability, recovery, latency, or cost threshold can be tested.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Discovery question bank path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Availability / RTO / RPO and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Write measurable targets and the evidence source for each.

check.command: review d2 evidence for Availability / RTO / RPO

scenarios.label: A residency or skill constraint arrives late
scenarios.root_cause: The chosen architecture cannot satisfy geography, regulation, or team capability.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Discovery question bank path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Data and Regulation and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Add the constraint to the decision record before service selection.

check.command: review d2 evidence for Data and Regulation
